title: Northwest Film Forum

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The cinemas have a bold, raw look, with hardwood floors, bare wood columns, and 20-foot-high ceiling. Parties of many sizes can be accommodated in our two theaters: Cinema 1 seats 110, and Cinema 2 accommodates 46. The lobby is also available for parties and receptions. To discuss availability & rates, please fill out the inquiry form. Email Director of Exhibition Cole Wilder, cole (at) nwfilmforum.org, with any questions. Weekdays = Mon-Thurs Weekends = Fri-Sun Daytime = ending at or before 6pm Evening = starting at or after 5pm The main floor of the Forum, including the theaters and lobby, are accessible via a ramp. We have one restroom on the main floor built to ADA standards.
